verdict.rationale: Penpot has a published pricing page (penpot.dev/pricing). The evidence shows only general plan bullets: unlimited teams, no file limits within storage capacity, and community plugins. Nothing in the pack shows seat types, named tiers or prices, or how AI/MCP features are gated by plan. missing for 10: documented seat types, named tier structure with prices, AI-feature gating per plan, independent corroboration of pricing clarity

support.subject: As a product manager, published plan pricing makes seat types, tiers, and AI-feature gating clear before procurement

citations.quote: No file limits. Create as many as you need within your storage capacity. ... Unlimited Teams. Collaborate freely with unlimited teams.
Use community plugins or build your own.
